scenario_name: Scenario D: Mixed Mobility with Restricted Stair Access

summary.memory_measurement_note: Python heap is measured by tracemalloc; process RSS is sampled with psutil at simulation-step boundaries.
summary.uncertainty_note: At least 20 completed paired seeds; report effect size, interval, and p-value together.

methodology_notes: Rigorous paired-seed evaluation across identical initial geometry, walking speeds, and physical crowd substrate. All density thresholds are physical simulation indicators and do not constitute validated physiological crush injury thresholds.
